messages:
axel: Heads-up — noticed a throughput dip on canary when requests fall back to variant B. Batches fragment into a lot of size-1/2 items and KV cache warmups spike. Anyone tracking compat-set routing impact?
maya: saw it too. quick tail numbers: p95 +320ms, batch_size_hist skewed to 1 and 2. :grimacing:
sam_k: I profiled a 10m window. paste of trimmed logs below:

```
batch_size_hist: {1: 64%, 2: 18%, 3-7: 10%, >=8: 8%}
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.39
avg_tokens_per_req: 42
queue_latency_ms_p50/p95: 12 / 86
kernel_select_switches: 0.7% (extra overhead when compat mismatch triggers different kernel path)
```

irene: interesting. smells like compat_set fragmentation + token_budget not being adaptive for fallbacks. When variant B is incompatible with A's kernel profile requests get split across different exec paths -> smaller batches.
axel: do we have a simple repro? or replay that isolates multi-model routing effect?
maya: i replayed traffic with routing forced to always pick a compatible variant (forced_compat=true). batch distribution normalized: size>=8 jumped 3x, p95 improved ~180ms.
perf-bot: perf-bot: automated microbench (trial id: multiroute-20260310) results: throughput +9% vs baseline, p95 latency -14% when grouping by compat_set.
sam_k: proposal: change queue policy to prefer_compat_grouping + dynamic token_budget per-compat-set. quick config idea:

```
queue_policy: {
  prefer_compat_grouping: true,
  token_budget_targets: {
    default: 1024,
    fallback_variant: 512,
    short_seq_workloads: 256
  },
  max_wait_ms: 25
}
```

irene: add KV affinity hint to routing: tag requests with kv_affinity_key derived from user/session so warm KV stays colocated -> fewer cold misses across variants. small sticky routing window (e.g., 10s) should help without sacrificing elasticity.
axel: tradeoffs? pref grouping may increase queue latency for first-in requests. how much tail do we trade for better batch efficiency?
maya: replay numbers: prefer_compat_grouping at 10% weight (A/B) -> cost/unit -11%, overall p95 +5% for short requests, p95 -20% for long seq paths. net depends on workload mix.
sam_k: plan: run canary with 10% traffic, enable prefer_compat_grouping + token_budget tweaks + kv_affinity for only fallback_variant. collect: batch_size_hist, kv_miss_rate, p50/p95 latency, cost_per_token.
axel: can we gate by request length? only enable grouping for avg_tokens > 32?
irene: yes. add a guard: if avg_tokens_estimate < 32 -> prefer_low_latency_mode (no waiting). reduces extra tail for short conversational queries.
perf-bot: perf-bot: created bench job -> job_id=bench/17721-multi-route-canary; will post live metrics.
deploy-bot: deployed canary route 'compat-grp-expt' -> traffic=10% id=canary-17721 at 1772104760
maya: monitoring dashboards: I'll add a per-compat-set panel and KV miss drilldowns. will alert if p95 regresses >10% for more than 5m.
axel: thanks all — starting the canary. will post results after 30m. :thumbsup:
